filesystem.name: read_file
filesystem.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system as text. Handles various text encodings and returns an error for paths outside the allowed directories.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path of the file to read.

filesystem.name: write_file
filesystem.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content. Use with caution as it will overwrite existing files without warning.

path.description: Path of the file to write.

content.description: Full text content to write to the file.

filesystem.name: list_directory
filesystem.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path. Results distinguish files from directories with [FILE] and [DIR] prefixes.

filesystem.name: search_files
filesystem.description: Recursively search for files and directories matching a pattern. Searches through all subdirectories from the starting path and matches names case-insensitively.

path.description: Directory to start the search from.

pattern.description: Substring or glob pattern to match against file names.

excludePatterns.description: Optional list of glob patterns to skip, such as node_modules.

filesystem.name: get_file_info
filesystem.description: Retrieve detailed metadata about a file or directory: size, creation time, last modified time, permissions, and whether it is a file or directory.

filesystem.name: create_directory
filesystem.description: Create a new directory or ensure a directory exists. Can create multiple nested directories in one operation, and succeeds silently if the directory already exists.

github.name: create_issue
github.description: Create a new issue in a GitHub repository. Provide a clear title and a body that describes the problem, the expected behavior, and steps to reproduce. Labels and assignees must already exist or be valid collaborators, otherwise the request is rejected with a validation error.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, for example 'acme-corp'. Case-insensitive.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner prefix, for example 'billing-service'.

title.description: Short summary of the issue, ideally under 80 characters.

labels.description: Names of existing labels to apply.

github.name: list_issues
github.description: List issues in a repository with optional filtering by state, labels, and update time. Results are sorted and paginated; pull requests are excluded. Use this to survey open work before creating a new issue so that duplicates are avoided.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, for example 'acme-corp'. Case-insensitive.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner prefix, for example 'billing-service'.

state.description: Filter by state: open, closed, or all. Defaults to open.

labels.description: Only return issues carrying all of these labels.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; only issues updated at or after this time are returned.

page.description: Page number for paginated results, starting at 1. Combine with perPage to walk large result sets.

perPage.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 30, maximum 100. Smaller pages return faster and use less context.

github.name: get_issue
github.description: Fetch the full details of a single issue by number, including title, body, state, labels, assignees, milestone, and timestamps. Comments are not included; use the comment listing tool for the discussion thread.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, for example 'acme-corp'. Case-insensitive.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner prefix, for example 'billing-service'.

issue_number.description: The number of the issue, as shown after the # sign in the web interface.

github.name: update_issue
github.description: Update an existing issue. Any field that is omitted is left unchanged, so send only what should change. Closing an issue with a state_reason of not_planned records that the work was declined rather than completed.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, for example 'acme-corp'. Case-insensitive.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner prefix, for example 'billing-service'.

issue_number.description: Number of the issue to update.

github.name: add_issue_comment
github.description: Add a comment to an existing issue or pull request conversation. The comment body supports GitHub-flavored Markdown, including task lists, mentions, and fenced code blocks. Rate limits apply to rapid successive comments.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, for example 'acme-corp'. Case-insensitive.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner prefix, for example 'billing-service'.

issue_number.description: Issue or pull request number to comment on.

github.name: create_pull_request
github.description: Open a new pull request from a head branch into a base branch. The head branch must already be pushed to the remote. Draft pull requests do not notify reviewers and cannot be merged until marked ready for review.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, for example 'acme-corp'. Case-insensitive.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner prefix, for example 'billing-service'.

head.description: Branch containing the changes, or user:branch for forks.

base.description: Branch the changes should be merged into.

draft.description: Open the pull request as a draft.

github.name: list_pull_requests
github.description: List pull requests in a repository, filtered by state, head branch, or base branch. Returns summaries only; request an individual pull request for its full description and review status. Results are paginated.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, for example 'acme-corp'. Case-insensitive.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner prefix, for example 'billing-service'.

base.description: Only pull requests targeting this branch.

page.description: Page number for paginated results, starting at 1. Combine with perPage to walk large result sets.

perPage.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 30, maximum 100. Smaller pages return faster and use less context.

github.name: get_pull_request_diff
github.description: Return the unified diff for a pull request. Large diffs are truncated by the server, so for very big changes prefer reading individual files. The diff includes file renames and binary file markers but not review comments.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, for example 'acme-corp'. Case-insensitive.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner prefix, for example 'billing-service'.

github.name: merge_pull_request
github.description: Merge a pull request using the chosen strategy. The call fails if required status checks have not passed, if there are unresolved merge conflicts, or if branch protection rules require approvals that are missing.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, for example 'acme-corp'. Case-insensitive.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner prefix, for example 'billing-service'.

merge_method.description: merge, squash, or rebase. Defaults to merge.

commit_title.description: Title for the merge commit when using merge or squash.

github.name: search_code
github.description: Search for code across GitHub repositories using the code search syntax. Supports qualifiers such as repo:, language:, path:, and filename:. Results show matching file paths and text fragments, and are limited to files under 384 KB on the default branch.

q.description: Search query including any qualifiers, for example 'addClass repo:jquery/jquery language:js'.

page.description: Page number for paginated results, starting at 1. Combine with perPage to walk large result sets.

perPage.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 30, maximum 100. Smaller pages return faster and use less context.

github.name: search_repositories
github.description: Find repositories by name, topic, language, or description. Supports qualifiers such as stars:>100, language:python, and topic:cli. Returns repository names, descriptions, star counts, and last update times for the top matches.

page.description: Page number for paginated results, starting at 1. Combine with perPage to walk large result sets.

perPage.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 30, maximum 100. Smaller pages return faster and use less context.

github.name: get_file_contents
github.description: Get the contents of a file or the entries of a directory from a repository at a given ref. Files larger than one megabyte are not returned inline. Use this to read source files without cloning the repository locally.

owner.description: Account or organization that owns the repository, for example 'acme-corp'. Case-insensitive.

repo.description: Repository name without the owner prefix, for example 'billing-service'.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA. Defaults to the default branch.

ripgrep-search.name: search_files
ripgrep-search.description: Search the contents of files under a directory for a regular expression using ripgrep. Returns matching lines with file paths and line numbers, and respects .gitignore rules by default.

path.description: Directory to search. Defaults to the workspace root.

ripgrep-search.name: read_file
ripgrep-search.description: Read a range of lines from a file, which is useful for large files where the whole content would be too long to include in the conversation.
